declaration: Treat left and right eye-tracking signals as independently available to research adapters, enabling one independently controlled foveating region per eye and independent per-eye gaze/movement prediction.

interpretation.decoupled: Independent observation and control; eye movements need not be statistically independent.
interpretation.foveation: Two separately positioned/parameterized foveating regions across the stereo pair; no requirement to share gaze center, radius or uncertainty margin.
interpretation.prediction: Estimate current gaze and optionally predict each eye toward a common intended presentation target; horizons derive from each eye's own sample timestamp.
interpretation.stereo: Preserve coherent stereo/source/warp identity and common presentation target. Independent gaze does not authorize mixing eye frames.

unverified: Rooted-device API access and data path
Actual per-eye sample rate, latency and timestamp semantics
Calibration, confidence semantics and tracking quality
fallback_policy: Specify bounded sample age and uncertainty limits. Widen regions or disable foveation for stale/invalid samples, blinks or excessive uncertainty; record each eye's fallback while preserving coherent stereo.
evidence_policy: Label synthetic/replayed gaze separately from device capture; an API/capture receipt is required before this assumed capability becomes a verified hardware observation.
manifest_binding: Reference this assumption ID and file hash in the hashed experiment configuration and gaze-data index. Do not add undeclared top-level fields to the strict v1 run manifest.
